items: Ultra-Stable A-Frame Structure for Bumper Harvest：The classic A-frame design creates a rock-solid triangular support, specifically engineered to withstand heavy fruit loads without bending. By maximizing vertical space and optimizing air circulation & sunlight exposure, it ensures your cucumbers and vines grow healthier, leading to a much more productive harvest

Weather-Proof & Plant-Safe Steel Core：Crafted with a heavy-duty steel core coated in premium UV-resistant plastic. Unlike 100% metal trellises that get scorching hot in summer, our plastic coating protects delicate tendrils from "heat burns." It’s 100% rust-proof and eco-friendly, ensuring it won't leach chemicals into your organic soil for years to come

Tool-Free Assembly in Under 10 Minutes：Say goodbye to frustration! Our innovative "Snap-Fit" connectors (Equal Tee & Cross) allow for quick, tool-free setup. Even gardening beginners can assemble it in minutes. When the season ends, it folds flat or disassembles effortlessly for compact storage, ready for next year's planting

Versatile & Adjustable for Any Garden Space：Standing at a generous 51"(L) x 53"(H), this trellis is a perfect fit for raised beds, traditional garden plots, or large containers. It’s the ultimate vertical support for a wide variety of climbers: cucumbers, peas, zucchini, squash, tomatoes, beans, grapes, and even decorative flowers

Complete All-in-One Gardening Kit：Get everything you need in one box! This value pack includes the 51x53" Trellis Frame, 1 heavy-duty climbing net (1.8*2.7m), 30 secure zip ties, and a full set of easy-to-use connectors. No extra trips to the hardware store—just unbox, set up, and watch your garden thrive

Dedicated Support & Component Assistance：We strive to provide premium garden products and ensure a positive experience. Each unit is inspected prior to shipment. Should you experience any transit issues or identify missing components, please contact us directly through Amazon messages. Our team is committed to assisting you with prompt solutions and necessary replacements to ensure your project proceeds smoothly
